# SelectMany

Collects the elements of an array property of each object in an array into one array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
SelectMany(items, fieldName)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array of objects to read, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. Elements that are not objects are left out. |
| `fieldName` | string | The name of the property that holds an array, matched exactly, case included. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. An object whose property is missing, or is not an array, adds nothing. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of the fieldName array of each object, in the order of the objects and then of each array's elements. Nested arrays among those elements are kept as they are. Never null.

## Example

`SelectMany([{"tags": ["a", "b"]}, {"tags": ["c"]}], "tags")` returns `["a", "b", "c"]`.
